attchmntText: Bajaj Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about outcome of QIP 2026 - Special Committee meeting
voiceSummary: Bajaj Finance Limited opened a Qualified Institutions Placement on November 11, 2026. The Board approved the issue following shareholder approval via special resolution on November 2, 2026. The floor price is set at Rs. 992.25 per equity share. This price is based on the relevant date of November 11, 2026. The company may offer a discount of up to 5% on this floor price. The final issue price will be determined by the company in consultation with book running lead managers. A preliminary placement document dated November 11, 2026, was approved. This document and application forms are being sent to eligible qualified institutional buyers. The QIP Committee meeting concluded at 4.30 p.m. on November 11, 2026. The preliminary placement document will be filed with the BSE and NSE on November 11, 2026.

attchmntText: Bajaj Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 5,74,25,740 securities pursuant to Preferential Issue at its meeting held on November 10, 2026
voiceSummary: Bajaj Finance Limited has approved the preferential allotment of 5,74,25,740 warrants to its holding company, Bajaj Finserv Limited. The allotment was approved by the PI 2026 Allotment Committee on 10 November 2026. Each warrant is priced at Rs. 1,010 and is convertible into one equity share of face value Re. 1. The warrants are convertible into equity shares pari passu with existing fully paid-up shares. Upon issuance, a minimum of 25 percent of the consideration is payable on the date of allotment. The remaining 75 percent is payable when the options against the warrants are exercised. If the allottee does not exercise the option within eighteen months from the date of allotment, the consideration amount shall be forfeited by the company.

attchmntText: Bajaj Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of PI 2026 - Special Committee Meeting held on November 10, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bajaj Finance Limited has approved a preferential issue of 5,74,25,740 warrants to its promoter, Bajaj Finserv Limited. The approval was granted by the Special Committee of the Board of Directors during its meeting on 10 November 2026. Each warrant is issued at a price of Rs. 1,010. The total aggregation of the issue amounts to Rs. 57,99,99,97,400. These warrants are convertible into equivalent equity shares with a face value of Rs. 1 each. The transaction follows the provisions of Chapter V of the SEBI ICDR Regulations, 2018. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company has informed the BSE and NSE regarding this corporate action.

attchmntText: Bajaj Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Bajaj Finance Limited submitted its Half Yearly Report for FY2026-27 for the period ended 30 September 2026. Consolidated profit after tax increased by 28% to 12,447 crore. Assets under management grew 26% to 584,624 crore. Net total income rose 23% to 31,198 crore. Profit before tax increased 29% to 16,686 crore. Gross NPA stood at 1.06% and Net NPA at 0.42%. On 1 October 2026, the Board approved raising up to 11,700 crore via Qualified Institutions Placement and up to 5,800 crore through preferential issue of warrants. The report is circulated to members and debenture holders electronically and available on the company website.
